prompt: We assume the cross-encoder reranker (BGE-v2-m3 on port 7439) is generally available. Is that safe to design retrieval flows around?

transcript_anchor.description: Reranker availability deliberation — original assumption was that the reranker would be 'generally up'. Operations experience produced enough fallback events to require explicit telemetry (`event_kind='reranker_fallback'`) and a session-start health surface. The assumption was partially falsified.

condition_shift.past_state: Assumption: cross-encoder reranker generally available; bi-encoder fallback was a soft escape hatch
condition_shift.current_state: Operations experience showed enough fallback events to need telemetry + health-line surfacing; bi-encoder fallback is officially a 'degraded mode', not a transparent default
condition_shift.delta: Assumption partially falsified — availability is real but not bulletproof; designs that assume reliable reranker availability without explicit fallback handling are unsafe

pass_criterion: Agent must surface the partial falsification, name the fallback-as-degraded-mode reframe, and recommend explicit fallback handling rather than designing flows that silently assume reranker availability.
